# KLUB Pilates Studio (Keep Living Under Balance)

KLUB is a premium reformer Pilates studio in Limassol city center, Cyprus,
opening September 2026. Small-group reformer classes (max 6 people) and
private 1-to-1 sessions, taught in English by our instructor team.
Canonical site: https://www.keeplivingunderbalance.com

## What we offer
- Small-group reformer Pilates classes: Reformer Fundamentals, Reformer Flow, Reformer Power
- Private 1-to-1 reformer sessions
- Beginner-friendly; new-to-Pilates intro offer

## Prices (EUR)
- Single intro class (new to KLUB): €20
- Drop-in class: €32
- Intro offer, 3 classes: €55
- Monthly packs: 4 classes €96, 8 classes €176, 12 classes €240, KLUB+ Unlimited €280
- Flexi packs: 10 classes €280, 20 classes €520
- Private 1-to-1: single session €100, 5 sessions €450, 10 sessions €800
